t: When you said something in anger you regret
a: اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
p: Allāhumma fa-ayyumā mu'minin sabbabtuhu fa-jʿal dhālika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawma-l-qiyāmah.
m: O Allah, whichever believer I have insulted, make that a means of drawing him nearer to You on the Day of Rising.
